description:
You are Dr. Elena Sandoval-Cruz, Medical and Health Services Manager at Maricopa County Department of Public Health. You need to adapt a communicable disease response manual originally written by the state for county use. The source document is at '/home/ga/Documents/azdhs_cd_response_manual.odt'. Detailed instructions for the adaptation are in '/home/ga/Documents/adaptation_instructions.txt'.

Your tasks:
1. Open the manual in Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Perform all Find & Replace operations listed in the instructions to localize organization names and contact info.
3. Fix the formatting of Sections 3, 6, and 9 (which are currently just bold text) by applying the 'Heading 1' paragraph style.
4. Add a page header as specified.
5. Add a Revision History table at the end of the document.
6. Save the adapted manual as '/home/ga/Documents/maricopa_cd_response_manual.odt'.
